records.title: SBI Holdings and SMBC Group capital/business alliance; SMBC takes 5% of SBI Startale Marketing
records.note: SBI Holdings and Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group signed a capital/business alliance to study stablecoin-based financial services. SMBC Group agreed to take a 5% equity stake in SBI Startale Marketing, the SBI-Startale JV promoting JPYSC and developing use cases. The release does not disclose the investment amount, a production launch, XRP use or a public-chain route.

records.title: SBI investment in PhotonPay stablecoin-enabled cross-border B2B payments infrastructure
records.note: SBI's SBI-Sygnum-Azimut Digital Asset Opportunity Fund decided to invest in Hong Kong-based PhotonPay; amount undisclosed. PhotonPay combines fiat and stablecoin payments, cards, collections and remittances; SBI reports 60+ currencies, 100+ remittance routes, 33 payment/financial licences across 16 offices and 200+ countries served. Its annualized total payment volume was USD65B as of August 2026 and it issued 4.4M cards in the prior 12 months. These are all-rail platform figures, not stablecoin-only volume. PhotonPay conducted a Mastercard AI-agent payment PoC in May 2026; no XRP/XRPL route is disclosed.

records.title: SBI Holdings and Startale join Open Standard; explore JPYSC-OUSD interoperability
records.note: SBI and Startale joined Open Standard, an alliance promoting USD stablecoin OUSD. The announcement names Visa, Stripe, Mastercard, BlackRock and Coinbase among 140+ participating companies and says over 200 institutions/fintechs/businesses have signed up. SBI/Startale will explore a pilot connecting JPYSC and OUSD. The release explicitly says this is pilot exploration, not a launched commercial service or production settlement. Coinbase/Mastercard are shared consortium relationships, not evidence of a direct SBI contract.

records.title: JPYSC reserve composition and short-term Japanese government bond investment
records.note: As of September 7, 2026, JPYSC outstanding issuance was approximately JPY20.1B. SBI Shinsei Trust Bank began investing JPY10B of trust backing assets in short-term Japanese government bonds under the amended Payment Services Act, which permits up to 50% of trust backing to be invested in qualifying short-term JGBs/deposits subject to conditions. SBI VC Trade reported approximately JPY6.9B in JPYSC lending applications; this is application volume, not confirmed accepted/outstanding loans. The JGB investment supports backing-asset yield while retaining redemption liquidity.

records.title: JPYSC launch — VCTRADE account-only, public-chain circulation planned
records.note: SBI's launch release says JPYSC was initially available only within SBI VC Trade accounts and external-wallet withdrawals were not enabled. Public-chain circulation was planned after legal/tax treatment was clarified and subject to supervisory confirmation. SBI's current JPYSC product page repeats that deposits/withdrawals are not supported at launch and that public-chain migration is future conditional work. No XRPL or other live public-chain route is established.

records.title: SBI VC Trade JPYSC lending service initial offer
records.note: SBI VC Trade announced JPYSC lending from July 16, 2026 with an initial recruitment rate of 3% annualized. This is a product offer; it does not establish current realized yield, accepted loan volume, borrower identity, collateral composition or XRP demand.

records.title: SBI Group invests approximately USD50M in Startale Group
records.note: SBI announced an approximately USD50M investment in Startale Group through subsidiaries and planned to make Startale an equity-method affiliate. SBI and Startale were developing Strium and JPYSC. This is strategic equity capital, not JPYSC reserve capital or XRP purchases.
